title: *CS614 GDB SOLUTION*
text:
*CS614 GDB SOLUTION* 

Cheap cloud storage and compute do not make traditional warehouse modeling obsolete; they make disciplined warehousing more important than ever. Dumping raw data into a lake without a star schema leaves every analyst to define metrics like “revenue” differently, which produces conflicting numbers and exactly the distrust the finance team fears. Cloud lowers the cost of storing and processing data, but it does not create consistent definitions, data quality, or a single version of truth, so ETL/ELT pipelines and dimensional modeling remain essential for trusted, governed reporting.
